description: This is a React-like component written using LightningJS framework, representing the main 'Notes' page of a note-taking application. It manages the display and interaction of header, search bar, notes list, and note editor components, and includes logic for state management, filtering, and keyboard shortcuts.

classes.name: Notes
classes.description: Main component managing the notes page layout, state, and interactions, built using LightningJS framework.

methods.name: filterNotes
methods.description: Filters and sorts the list of notes based on the search query, prioritizing recent updates.

methods.name: onNew
methods.description: Callback to initiate creation of a new note.

methods.name: onSelect
methods.description: Selects a note by its ID.

methods.name: onEdit
methods.description: Enables editing mode for the selected note.

methods.name: onSave
methods.description: Saves the current note with the provided payload.

methods.name: handleKeydown
methods.description: Handles global keyboard shortcuts for creating, saving notes.
